album.title: The Mirza Abdollah Radif for Tar and Setar, Vol. 5

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on C5 and dwells most on C in Mansuri. The line peaks at Dk5 (548.0 Hz) at 0:50.0. It closes on Ak4, not the tonic (C5 → G4 → Ak4 → Ak4 → Ak4 → Ak4).
